predecessor_failure.decision: predecessor remains disabled; its tolerance is not relaxed

prior_observation_boundary.scope: One development-only benzene atom-0/x stencil was run before this full admission contract was frozen; no water full-Cartesian, translation-force, rotation-force, or closed-loop result had been observed.
prior_observation_boundary.threshold_policy: The 2e-4 eV/A local-force threshold is inherited unchanged from the failed predecessor preregistration; the full panel and symmetry/loop thresholds were frozen before their execution.

frozen_runtime_contract.permanent_source_kernel: invariant exterior point multipoles projected to complete harmonic coefficients
frozen_runtime_contract.induced_source_kernel: normalized sigma=1.5-A Gaussian multipoles projected to complete harmonic coefficients
frozen_runtime_contract.receiver_kernel: minus exact transpose of the normalized sigma=1.5/3.0-A Gaussian harmonic source operator
frozen_runtime_contract.continuum: smooth weighted harmonic Galerkin A=E.T*K*E with fixed coefficient topology
frozen_runtime_contract.force_derivative: fourth-order central Richardson derivative of the complete re-solved scalar
frozen_runtime_contract.force_topology_policy: identical fixed coefficient topology hash at center and every stencil point
frozen_runtime_contract.force_displacement_policy: rebuild E,K,point/Gaussian source maps,A,b and both-start root at every point

decision_rule.pass: Attach the two replicated evidence artifacts and admit only experimental electrostatic E plus runtime-error-bounded numerical scalar-gradient F for this exact profile. Keep H/V/M false and retain all per-call root/topology/Richardson guards.
decision_rule.fail: Keep E/F/H/V/M false, retain the run as negative evidence, and do not relax the frozen force/root/symmetry/loop thresholds.

inherited_v1_contract.claim_boundary: A replicated pass addresses the GEPOL active-point force blocker and admits one experimental electrostatic scalar plus its numerical scalar-gradient force. It does not admit chemical accuracy, complete solvation free energy, analytic force, Hessian/frequency, MD, or Tier V.

claim_boundary.candidate_admission: Only the exact experimental electrostatic scalar E and its runtime-error-bounded fourth-order Richardson numerical scalar-gradient F may become true after the complete v2 sequence passes.
